instructions.name: fund_sol
docs: Anyone: add SOL straight to the jackpot (all of it; no team share). Goes to the
current round while its countdown runs, otherwise to the next round.

instructions.name: harvest_damm
docs: Permissionless, after migration: claim fees from an LP position the treasury owns in
the DAMM v2 pool (DAMM checks the treasury holds the position NFT), then split them.

instructions.name: harvest_dbc
docs: Permissionless: claim the trading fees the treasury is owed on the DBC pool, as fee
claimer (partner share) and/or pool creator (creator share), in SOL, then split them.

instructions.name: harvest_dbc_surplus
docs: Permissionless, once the curve has completed: claim the treasury's share of the
surplus SOL left over from the final buy (each side can only claim once), then split it.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Binds the game to a token launched on Meteora DBC, paired with SOL, collecting fees
in SOL, and whose fees reach the game: the treasury must be the pool's fee claimer,
its creator, or both. Round 1 opens now; only buys from here on count.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: and owns the SOL vault and stash.

accounts.name: wsol_vault
docs: Jackpots and the team's share, as wrapped SOL.

accounts.name: stash
docs: Catches any fees paid in the game token (only possible in DAMM v2 pools that collect
both sides); they stay here.

instructions.name: record_buy
docs: Keeper-only: report a qualifying buy seen on the token's Meteora pools. Buys must
be reported in chain order, inside the round, and at least `min_buy_lamports`. Each one
adds `time_add_per_buy` to the countdown, capped at `max_timer` after the buy.
`sig` is the swap's transaction signature, kept in the event so anyone can audit it.

instructions.name: set_authority
docs: Hand admin rights to another key (e.g. a multisig). Passing `Pubkey::default()`
renounces them for good: nobody can sign as it, so keeper and team wallet freeze.

instructions.name: set_damm_config
docs: Fix the DAMM v2 config if the migration used a different one than expected.
Only allowed before the DBC pool has migrated.

instructions.name: set_team
docs: Change where the team's 20% goes. Whatever is already owed goes to the new wallet.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Permissionless, once the countdown has run out plus `settle_grace_secs` (time for the
keeper to report buys that landed just before zero). Pays the whole jackpot, in SOL,
to the last buyer in this same instruction, records the winner, and opens the next
round. A round with no buys carries its jackpot over.

accounts.name: payout
docs: Temporary account the jackpot passes through to become plain SOL (closed in this ix).

accounts.name: winner
docs: ever receives SOL.

instructions.name: withdraw_team
docs: Anyone: send the team's accumulated share to the team wallet as plain SOL.

errors.name: WrongPool
errors.msg: Pool or config does not belong to this game's token

errors.name: FeesNotInSol
errors.msg: The pool must collect its fees in SOL (quote token)

errors.name: NoFeesToGame
errors.msg: The game's fee address is neither the pool's fee claimer nor its creator

errors.name: NotKeeper
errors.msg: Only the keeper can report buys

errors.name: BuyTooSmall
errors.msg: Buy is below the minimum that counts

errors.name: BuyBeforeRound
errors.msg: Buy happened before this round started

errors.name: BuyAfterDeadline
errors.msg: Buy happened after the countdown ran out

errors.name: BuyOutOfOrder
errors.msg: Buys must be reported once each, in chain order

errors.name: WinnerAccountMismatch
errors.msg: Winner account must be passed exactly when the round has a winner

errors.name: WrongTeam
errors.msg: That is not the game's team wallet

fields.name: team_owed
docs: Team share claimed but not yet sent (lamports).

fields.name: recent
docs: Ring buffers for the website: latest counted buys and latest winners.

fields.name: keeper
docs: The only key allowed to call `record_buy`.

fields.name: team
docs: Receives the team's 20% of fees (as plain SOL, via `withdraw_team`).

fields.name: damm_config
docs: DAMM v2 config the DBC pool migrates into; determines the DAMM pool address.

fields.name: min_buy_lamports
docs: Smallest buy (SOL into the pool, in lamports) that counts.

fields.name: time_add_per_buy
docs: Seconds each counted buy adds to the countdown.

fields.name: max_timer
docs: The countdown never exceeds this many seconds after the latest buy.

fields.name: initial_timer
docs: Countdown when a round opens.

fields.name: settle_grace_secs
docs: Seconds after zero before anyone can settle, so late-reported buys still count.

fields.name: total_lamports
docs: Total SOL (lamports) of counted buys this round.

fields.name: jackpot
docs: Jackpot in lamports.

fields.name: next_round_pot
docs: Lamports already set aside for the next round.

fields.name: amount
docs: Jackpot paid, in lamports.
